body.label: Target
body.html: Up to two enemies within ranged Weapon Range.

body.label: Effect
body.html: Trigger: An enemy ranged Action misses you while another enemy is within 2 units of its source. Response: On success, deal 1 weapon Damage to each selected target.

surges.html: Ignore 1 point of cover bonus against one target.
One hit target is Distracted until the start of your next turn.
